text:
raj: FYI provisioning backlog in us-west-2 — a bunch of gpu nodes are stuck in init because they can't decrypt instance disk keys. Seen ~40 nodes failing in the last 20m.
raj: allocator logs: `ERROR: kms: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection refused`
sara: I just checked network ACLs — security pushed a new egress baseline that denies 10.200.0.0/16 yesterday. Our keystore (internal-kms) is in that range.
tom: that explains it. nodes call internal-kms for CMK unwrap during boot -> if KMS unreachable, node can't start services and sits as `joining`.
infra-bot: alert: gpu-onboard-decrypt-failure_usw2 (severity=critical) — 42 affected
irene: quick mitigation options: 1) add scoped egress allow for internal-kms IPs (fast) 2) move keystore behind approved NAT/proxy (safer, takes longer) 3) run local decrypt shim fetching secrets from control plane via approved channel (not ideal)
security: we can do a temporary allow but require audit annotation + timeboxed rule. We prefer creating an exception ticket before changes go live.
raj: we need rapid mitigation to avoid paying for idle GPUs. Can security approve a 30m allow to 10.200.3.21:443 from sg=compute-warmup?
security: provisional ok for 30m. Please attach justification in change request and include infra owner + PM.
sara: created PR `infra/egress-allow-kms-usw2` with plan. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "egress_allow_kms_temp" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.200.3.21/32"]
  description       = "TEMP allow to internal-kms for node decrypt - 30m"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
}
```
deploy-bot: apply started infra/egress-allow-kms-usw2 at 1856012440 by sara
tom: staging canary (3 nodes) resumed and decrypted disks. rolling to 10-node canary now. set ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug for these to capture handshake info.
infra-bot: canary success: 3/3 warmed at 1856012480
raj: cost note: monitor warm-pool billing during rollout; idle VMs doubling rate previously.
security: audit note recorded: temporary egress rule approved (sara/tom/raj), TTL 30m, purpose: restore KMS connectivity for node onboarding. Follow-up required: 1) add internal-kms to approved egress proxy 2) change-control doc for exceptions 3) e2e test for decrypt path.
sara: rolling to prod 3->10->40 nodes. decrypt failures dropping to 0.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/egress-allow-kms-usw2 completed at 1856012585 by sara
irene: opening infra#4682 to implement proxy route and remove need for exceptions. Also assigning to security for exception process doc.
raj: closing alert. big thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
